ref: #2 §5 Statistics: sum, average and count work per context ("Sum of values X1 to Xi of a context") [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/43/c4cdfc334824478090739c04c4a249/content.htm] [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bfbd16f66d33de4e10000000a42189e.html]; assumed reading of #75: a context without a value sums to 0, as XPath's sum(()) does; obs-statistic decides it
note: Empty contexts: o1 has no Line and o2's one Line has no Qty, so Qty in context Order is (empty) | (empty) | 4. Each empty context gives 0: V is 0, 0, 4. Giving no value for an empty context would leave the first two Items without V.
